business_problem: Thematic needed to turn large volumes of unstructured customer feedback from multiple channels into accurate, reliable intelligence that could explain customer-experience metrics such as Net Promoter Score and help clients act on them quickly.
solution_summary: Thematic uses generative AI on AWS to convert large-scale customer feedback into business intelligence for enterprise clients. Feedback from multiple channels is fed into Thematic’s analysis workflow, where the company uses Amazon Bedrock to evaluate and compare large language models and to generate curated, reliable customer-intelligence outputs. This builds on Thematic’s earlier NLP-based feedback analysis by adding a simpler way to experiment with and operationalize modern foundation models for qualitative insight generation. The platform connects themes from unstructured comments to business metrics such as Net Promoter Score and helps clients understand what is driving satisfaction or dissatisfaction at scale. With AWS, Thematic can analyze millions of feedback data points and continuously tune its approach across more than 10 LLM candidates.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Provides the large language model layer Thematic uses to analyze customer feedback and generate reliable intelligence.

data_flow: Customer feedback from multiple channels is ingested into Thematic's analytics workflow, processed with Amazon Bedrock to identify themes and generate insights, and then connected back to customer-experience metrics such as Net Promoter Score.
business_outcome: Thematic uses generative AI to transform millions of customer feedback data points into actionable customer intelligence, helping large enterprises such as Atlassian, DoorDash, and Woolworths derive more accurate and reliable insight from qualitative feedback.
